summary: Validate exact source-hub candidate governance before publication

delivery.outcome: In the recognized source hub, validate exact candidate governance against governance/manifest.hub.json with accepted base, exact head, and CI actor before expensive source suites and before PR publication; route workspace-check to scripts/workspace_lifecycle_check.py in the source hub; reject invalid --ticket before preflight suites; include preflight duration in total workflow timing.
nonGoals: Do not weaken source-hub suites or target repository governance gates.
Do not modify dependency manifests or lockfiles.

architecture.decision: Prioritize source-hub detection in _governance_gate even when an incidental .governance directory exists, invoke scripts/governance_check.py with governance/manifest.hub.json and --actor ci before run_source_hub_health and deliver_pull_request, route workspace-check to scripts/workspace_lifecycle_check.py for source hubs, and validate canonical --ticket and start timing before preflight in execute_push_workflow.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of the ticket-217 commit.
